previousExperiment.carryForward: Preserve the original owner-local ledger and settled receipts. The arithmetic remainder is not new authorization. No new attempt may be issued before separate explicit authorization and a new bounded plan.

factors.name: schema
factors.comparison: Hold model, exact endpoint, source, prompt, sampling and output limits constant; compare prompt-only baseline with schema-and-required-route treatment. Schema/routing is the declared transport treatment, not prompt improvement.

factors.name: prompt
factors.comparison: Hold model, endpoint and transport contract constant; compare the frozen original and versioned new instruction. Meeting 1.0.1 candidate is distinct from installed 1.0.0.

factors.name: model
factors.comparison: Hold source, prompt and transport contract constant where supported; record provider/endpoint differences. If these cannot be held, attribute observations only to the new combination.

design.inputs: Include the original A–F and new paired corpus variants, plus owner-reviewed held-out variants with different values, units, speakers and relative times. Freeze selection and rubric before dispatch.
design.assessment: Separate transport/shape, content/attribution and human usefulness. Blind paired order where feasible. Preserve failures, refusals and missing data. One fresh response per case is a smoke check, not a statistical quality estimate.
design.approvalRequired: Exact cases, factors, attempt count, model/endpoint capabilities, request hashes, output caps and monetary bound must be approved. This plan specifies no executable inference adapter and grants no budget.
design.noRetries: No automatic retry, model/route fallback, paid verifier, JSON repair request or reuse of an uncertain operation. Reserve/fsync before dispatch; stop on unknown billing.

timing.clockPolicy: Use one monotonic clock per measured interval and identify each process/clock. Never sum remote generation metadata with local wall-clock.
timing.missing: Record null/unobserved, never invent timestamps. Buffered requestUrl exposes delivery but not first-byte/body-complete. Record timeout of the wait separately from the underlying transport completion.

reasoningCompatibility.observation: All six original requests set reasoning.enabled=false, while all six envelopes reported nonzero reasoning token usage. Cause/layer is unproven; no reasoning text is published.
reasoningCompatibility.futureCheck: Under separate authorization, compare frozen request reasoning controls with safe usage counters, finish status and billing receipt. Count all returned billed output within the cap; do not add model-specific no_think commands or globally alter sampling.
